content.text:
The fix was narrow: `nanoid` (a well-maintained id-gen package) was already wired into `generateCardId()` in `src/decks/deck-repository.ts`, but since it ships ESM-only with no CJS build, Jest couldn't parse it and `deck-repository.spec.ts` failed to run. I updated `jest.config.js` to extend jest-expo's default `transformIgnorePatterns` so `nanoid` gets transformed like the other allow-listed packages, rather than left as raw ESM for Node's CJS `require`. Full test suite (18/18 suites, 95/95 tests), typecheck, and lint all pass now.

Per this repo's workflow (AGENTS.md), changes land via PR after a plan is agreed on — this was a single well-scoped fix, so let me know if you'd like me to open a PR for it.
